A '''floating pond''' was a type of conveyance that, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], had come into common use by members of the aquatic [[Iyra]] [[Species/Legends|species]] when traveling on land. The vehicle consisted of a pool of [[Water/Legends|water]] mounted on a [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsled]]. The rider submerged themselves in the liquid and relied upon the sled's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] for mobility.<ref name="GG4b" />

==Behind the scenes==
Floating ponds are mentioned as a means for Iyra to move about on land in the sourcebook [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]], part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' line from [[West End Games]] that was published in [[1994]]. Although this version of the book is an update by author [[Chuck Truett]]<ref name="GG4b" /> of the [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races|previous edition]], written by [[Troy Denning]] and published in [[1989]],<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> the information about floating ponds is unique to the update.<ref name="GG4b" />
